sar.narrative: Customer C06988, holder of card C06988-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-12-01 and 2016-12-01, 4 transaction(s) totalling $158.60 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3503831 and the transaction that triggered review being 3503990 for $31.70. The activity was conducted through the online channel. The transactions originated from device profile 'BLADE V8Q Build/N2G47H |  | chrome generic for android', which the issuer's identity record marks 'Found' for this account, reached through an anonymous proxy. The purchases were made without the physical card, from a device with no prior history on the account. The same origin appears on 2 other card(s) belonging to unrelated customers within the same window, including C00294-K2, C02181-K2, indicating a common actor across multiple cardholders rather than an isolated compromise. Closed investigation CC-3471 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.97 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $158.60.
